color.worst_reason: The agent version uses a flat orange hero instead of the teal gradient, and contact card icon backgrounds use pastel tints rather than the reference's green/teal accents.

typography.worst_reason: Heading weights, button labels, and pill text styling are very similar with only minor differences in heading scale.

assets.worst_reason: Some icons appear as placeholder boxes/squares in the generated version (e.g., tab icons, plan badges, recharge inputs, store list items) where reference shows proper icons.

proportion.worst_reason: Button padding, card sizing, and overall spacing are nearly identical with only subtle layout differences.

states.worst_reason: Active tab (Móvil), selected Volaris Plan toggle, and highlighted 'Pro' column states are preserved consistently with the reference.

home.explanation: The score is held back by missing sections (top_bar, promo_banner, status_bar, and footer all scoring 0.00) and placeholder boxes replacing proper icons across tabs, plan badges, recharge inputs, and store listings (assets 2/5).

internet.explanation: The score is held back primarily by missing or mismatched navigation content (promo_bar at 0.00, main_nav at 0.27, sub_promo_bar at 0.38) and weak generic/footer text replication (status_bar at 0.00, footer at 0.33), indicating the agent failed to reproduce the header and footer copy accurately.

movil.explanation: The score is held back primarily by widespread missing text content across nearly every section (top_bar, promo_banner, features_highlights, and footer all near zero F1), and by broken asset rendering where emojis and flag icons appear as placeholder boxes instead of proper glyphs.

paquetes.explanation: The score is held back by missing/empty content in the top_bar, promo_banner, and footer sections (0.00 F1 scores) and by the use of generic placeholder square icons instead of the reference's colored illustrated icons (house, people, rocket) in card headers and the streaming services area.

tiendas.explanation: The score is held down by missing/empty content in the promo banner, nav, status banner, and videocall CTA sections (all 0.00 F1), and by weak visual fidelity in color (flat orange hero instead of the teal gradient) and assets (generic placeholder icons replacing the reference's distinct illustrative icons).
